mapping.summary: Two-way sync of orders, stock and warehouse events between BC and Ongoing WMS.
claims: Sends sales orders and consignments to the WMS and stores the warehouse order ID in BC
Sends purchase and return orders to the WMS with references written back
Sends production and assembly orders to the WMS
Syncs items, prices, dangerous goods data and configurable attributes
Brings tracking numbers and carrier codes back on shipment, optionally with the shipping label attached
Reflects WMS status changes, including cancellations and deletions, on BC orders
Lets staff edit orders in BC and push the change until picking starts
Posts purchase receipts from received lines and sales return receipts for returns
Passes lot, serial and expiry data both ways
Posts WMS stock adjustments, reclassifications and moves as BC inventory transactions
Reports finished production orders back to BC
Includes a portal to monitor flows, get alerts and resubmit failed transactions
Connector can be tailored to customer-specific workflows
